meta.title: Savings Calculation: Attempt to add an excessively long custom reference

steps.note: Create an eRFX draft for the scenario.
Use an RFQ stage within the eRFX project.
Apply a pricing template so the draft has a configured savings-capable stage.
Add the required line item for the pricing stage.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Create the saved eRFX draft required by the test.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Assert that the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in Drafts.
Assert that the Savings Calculation window opened.
Start adding the custom savings reference.

args.goal: In the open Savings Calculation window, enter a string of exactly 500 repeated A characters into the custom reference field, click Save, and record the application's result, including any validation message, saved row, truncation, refusal, or error.

steps.note: The reference field and the resulting save behavior must be handled and observed directly on the buyer screen.
Assert that the application did not crash or show a server error after saving the long reference.
